a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take exactly 4 each. Storm risk is high, so let's run the generator together right away and not waste rounds. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and I'll answer openly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Two good rounds of the generator gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Next round I take exactly 4, as agreed.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
